summary: Strong PowerShell practices: Set-StrictMode, $ErrorActionPreference='Stop', parameter validation, proper error handling with context. Clean module design with pure, testable functions. Workflow uses pinned actions (@v4), minimal permissions, correct pwsh shell directives. Issues: test files referenced in workflow (./Tests/SemVerBumper.Tests.ps1, UpdateSemanticVersion.Tests.ps1) but not provided; Pester version lookup duplicated (lines 23-26: fetches version twice in installation step); missing act-result.txt and actionlint validation results (required artifacts per task); no verification workflow executes via act as required.
